prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training with high carbohydrate intake and proper meal timing around 2-hour morning run

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers full 24 hours with 4-5 meals
Includes pre-run, during-run (if applicable), and post-run nutrition timing
Provides high carbohydrate content appropriate for endurance athlete (minimum 55-60% of calories)
Respects vegetarian diet and nut-free restrictions
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with an endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high carbohydrate intake and specific timing around training sessions

prompt_inputs.goal: Maximize strength and power for weightlifting competition in 2 weeks

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers exactly 1 day with 4-5 meals
Protein distributed across all meals (minimum 25g per meal)
Total daily protein supports 1.6-2.0g per kg bodyweight
Recovery nutrition (carbs + protein) included within 2 hours post-workout
No dairy-based products due to lactose intolerance

prompt_inputs.goal: Pre-match fueling and recovery for soccer performance
prompt_inputs.restrictions: Vegan (no animal products including dairy and eggs)

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals and includes plant-based protein sources (legumes, tofu, nuts, seeds) adequate for athletic recovery
Plan is compact and concise (suitable for 1-day format without excessive detail)
Meals support soccer performance with appropriate carbohydrate and calorie distribution for training/match day
